## What's Changed
* 新增可跨设备同步的章节阅读记录 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/5
* 移除 CloudKit 同步并更新 README by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/6
* 改进漫画双页拼接、配对与缩放拖动 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/7
* 改用静态发布清单检查 Willow 更新 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/8
* 新增绿色出行与来源可见性设置 by @intitni in https://github.com/intitni/Willow/pull/9


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/intitni/Willow/compare/version/1.0.1...version/1.1.0

附件含未签名 IPA、MPL-2.0 对应源码和 SHA-256 校验文件。[安装与许可说明](https://github.com/intitni/Willow/blob/version/1.1.0/README.md)
